name: stylesmith
description: A safe way to customize VS Code: your own CSS and JS, with its security policy kept on. A retro and cyberpunk style kit: themes, icons, fonts and effects.

stylesmith.imports.markdownDescription: URLs of `.css` and `.js` files to add to VS Code, e.g. `file:///C:/Users/me/custom.css`. File URLs support variables such as `${userHome}`. Only read from your user settings. Run **Stylesmith: Reload** after changing this.

stylesmith.allowRemoteImports.markdownDescription: Allow `https://` URLs in `stylesmith.imports`. Off by default: remote files can change at any time, and they run with full access to your editor. `http://` is never allowed.

stylesmith.effects.caretAnimation.markdownDescription: Animate the text cursor: it glides to its new position with a short trail. Built into Stylesmith, no file needed. Run **Stylesmith: Reload** after changing this.

stylesmith.effects.neonCurrentLine.markdownDescription: Give the line with the cursor thin neon lines and a faint gradient, and a glowing line number with a neon marker in the gutter. Nothing is drawn over your code. Uses your theme's focus color; set `--stylesmith-neon` in your own CSS to change it. Run **Stylesmith: Reload** after changing this.

stylesmith.effects.neonFocusFrame.markdownDescription: Give the editor you're typing in a soft neon frame and its active tab a glowing underline. Uses your theme's focus color; set `--stylesmith-neon` in your own CSS to change it. Run **Stylesmith: Reload** after changing this.

stylesmith.effects.neonSelections.markdownDescription: Give selected text, search matches and matching brackets a soft neon glow. Run **Stylesmith: Reload** after changing this.

stylesmith.effects.crtScanlines.markdownDescription: Show faint CRT scanlines over the whole window, like an old monitor. Set `--stylesmith-scanlines` (default `0.12`) in your own CSS to change the strength. Run **Stylesmith: Reload** after changing this.

stylesmith.effects.typingSparks.markdownDescription: Throw small neon sparks from the cursor as you type. Set `--stylesmith-spark-colors` in your own CSS to change the colors. Run **Stylesmith: Reload** after changing this.

stylesmith.effects.bootSequence.markdownDescription: Show a short retro boot log when VS Code starts. Any key skips it; it's skipped when your system is set to reduce motion. Run **Stylesmith: Reload** after changing this.

stylesmith.effects.glitchOnSave.markdownDescription: Make the editor glitch for a moment (a quick red/cyan split) when you save a file. Skipped when your system is set to reduce motion. Run **Stylesmith: Reload** after changing this.

stylesmith.fonts.enabled.markdownDescription: Use a bundled Nerd Font (with icons) in the editor and terminal. Stylesmith puts it first in `editor.fontFamily` and `terminal.integrated.fontFamily`, keeps your current fonts as fallbacks, and puts your settings back when you run **Stylesmith: Disable**. Nothing is installed on your system.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Modern and very readable, with ligatures. Regular and bold. Based on JetBrains Mono.
Classic IBM terminal feel. Regular and bold. Based on IBM Plex Mono.
Sci-fi, cyberpunk HUD look. Based on Share Tech Mono.
Pixel-style retro terminal. Sharpest at font sizes that are multiples of 11. Based on Departure Mono.
stylesmith.fonts.family.markdownDescription: Which bundled Nerd Font to use when `stylesmith.fonts.enabled` is on. Run **Stylesmith: Reload** after changing this.

stylesmith.statusbar.description: Show the Stylesmith button in the status bar. It opens a menu with presets, effects and fonts.

stylesmith.remindAfterUpdate.description: After a VS Code update removes Stylesmith's changes, offer to re-apply them.

scripts.format: prettier --write src assets scripts eslint.config.mjs tsconfig.json package.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src assets scripts eslint.config.mjs tsconfig.json package.json

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Stylesmith only reads user settings, and ${workspaceFolder} imports are skipped in untrusted workspaces.
